display.purpose: The hero disc state word and screen-owning moments; Schibsted Grotesk 600 at 30.

body-small.purpose: Secondary copy at 13/400 — capped at two lines; longer copy uses body.

telemetry-num.purpose: Speeds, byte counters — 21/600 with tabular figures (tnum), never jitter.

mono.purpose: Endpoints, keys, IPs, DNS servers, package names — all machine data. The shared mono text style (monoTextStyle) pins 14/20 with zero tracking; smaller mono usages (package names 13sp, version string 12sp) are sanctioned per-component exceptions (amended 2026-09-21, device review C4).

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system: dialogs, dropdowns, the selected segment, and focused fields — lifted sheets over the bare canvas. Resting sheets carry none; the bottom bar is docked and casts nothing; the search pill is a filled field (2026-09-21 device review C6). Android scales ambient/spot alphas by ~0.039/~0.19, so full-alpha ambient + 0x99 spot land at ~3.9%/~11% effective — the old web-token alphas (0.06/0.08) rendered at ~0.2%/1.5% and were invisible.

motion.name: film
motion.purpose: Ladder-step tone change on press = +1 film. Shipped as an instant tone swap — reduced-motion-legal by construction; the 200ms figure describes intent, not code.

motion.name: fill
motion.purpose: Hero disc fill, canvas↔sage, when the disc gains or loses its sage. Shipped as a 260ms animateColorAsState tween (FastOutSlowIn); snaps under reduced motion.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: +1-film press feedback. Shipped as an instant tone swap, feedback preserved; the 90ms figure describes intent, not code.

motion.name: breath
motion.purpose: Breathing dot, opacity only; static at 1.0 under reduced motion; samples about ten times a second, not every frame, keeping an idle screen cheap. Nothing slides, nothing scales.

components.name: Tab Header
components.description: The one shared header opening every tab (device review 2026-09-21, C9/X1): title 12dp below the top bar, intro 4dp under the title, content 16dp below; a trailing action aligns to the title's first baseline.
components.html:

narrative.overview: A warm paper board — canvas deepened one film at a time — with sage, slate, and lavender ink; cut-paper seams instead of shadows and honest telemetry. Vaayil's interface is a calm household guardian: it states the truth plainly — protected or not — in an atmosphere of domestic quiet. Security through peace, not urgency.
keyCharacteristics: Light-only: cream canvas and paper films — identical on every device, day or night.
Depth is layered paper: tonal films, closed 1dp seams, one lifted shadow reserved for real overlays.
Sage means sanctuary: active/verified states and affirmation actions; clay means error; amber means warning; lavender accents DNS/advanced; slate governs transport data.
Sans for UI (Schibsted Grotesk), monospace for data, tabular figures for telemetry.

rules.name: The Daylight Is the Brand Rule
rules.body: One light palette from Vaayil, not the wallpaper. Dynamic color and dark themes are prohibited; the app renders identically on every device, day or night.

rules.name: The Sage Means Sanctuary Rule
rules.body: Sage marks active tunnel states, verified cryptography, and affirmation buttons — nothing else. Errors are clay, warnings amber, DNS/advanced accents lavender, transport data slate.

rules.name: The Data Speaks Mono Rule
rules.body: If a string is something the tunnel consumes or produces — an endpoint, a key, an IP, a DNS address, a rule target, a statistic — it renders in monospace; live telemetry numbers use tabular figures. No exceptions.

rules.name: The Film Rule
rules.body: Depth is paper, not shadow. One film = OKLCH ΔL −0.0206 ±0.0008, ΔC +0.0050 ±0.0012, hue 85° ±6°; the ladder ships as six static hexes and nesting caps at three cumulative films. Seams are 1dp #CEC2A9, one closed perimeter (amended 2026-09-21: a single inset drawRoundRect stroke; sub-48dp decorative tiles carry fill only); Modifier.border is banned. The single shadow, sheet-lift, belongs to lifted sheets alone.

dos: Do keep surfaces in the canvas-and-film ladder; the palette has no dark mode.
Do reserve sage for sanctuary states and affirmation actions.
Do render machine data in monospace and telemetry in tabular Schibsted Grotesk.
Do carry load-bearing boundaries on stroke-3; hairline and seam are decoration.
Do honor reduced motion: fills swap instantly, dots sit static, feedback is preserved.
Do show real telemetry only; an empty slot stays quiet rather than decorative.
donts: Don't enable Material You dynamic color or ship a dark variant.
Don't use Modifier.border and don't leave any edge undrawn — the seam is one closed perimeter drawn by the shared seam modifier; an open bracket reads as a broken card.
Don't cast a shadow anywhere except a lifted sheet.
Don't stack films past three — a fourth film is a development error, not a color.
Don't put warning-mark or error-mark on text; marks stroke, on-colors carry text.
Don't consumer-VPN-market it: no neon gradients, no fear-urgency banners, no globe maps, no fake speedometers.
Don't add motion beyond state feedback; nothing slides, nothing scales.
Don't reach for a dialog when an inline explanation will do.
